responsibility: Defines the shared Xtensa bare-metal TargetOptions baseline, including little-endian no-OS identity, GNU-style linking, static relocation, aborting panics, and limited atomic support for Xtensa targets.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/xtensa.rs`, this Xtensa file only provides the shared bare-metal `TargetOptions` baseline such as endianness, GNU linker flavor, static relocation, aborting panics, and atomic support, not function-call register/stack classification.
